IS_TEST().notice: Marker used by Forge to identify test contracts.

failed().notice: Returns true if any test assertion has failed.

targetSenders().notice: Returns sender allowlist configured via `targetSender` (empty means no sender allowlist).

test_EdgeCase1_SingleReleaseGuarantee().notice: Test Case 1: Releasing a child reservation credits its parent exactly once;         repeated release attempts cannot credit it again.

test_EdgeCase2_AncestorRevocationThenDes.notice: Test Case 2: Revoking an ancestor that has descendants, then reclaiming an expired descendant,         cannot double-credit any ancestor.

test_EdgeCase3_ExpiredGrantBudgetConserv.notice: Test Case 3: An expired grant remains reserved until reclamation is confirmed,         and reclamation releases exactly its remaining capacity.

test_EdgeCase4_OrderIndependencePrevents.notice: Test Case 4: Delegation and reclamation in either transaction order cannot oversubscribe a parent.

test_EdgeCase5_FullLifecycleTraceWithInv.notice: Test Case 5: Full lifecycle walkthrough with invariant verification after every state transition.
